name: cctab
description: Telegram push when a long Claude Code task finishes, carrying what it cost and how much of your rate limit it burned. Approve permission prompts with two buttons. Tune it from your phone.

bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
bot_token.description: Talk to @BotFather, send /newbot, paste the token it gives you.

chat_id.title: Telegram chat ID (optional)
chat_id.description: Leave empty. Send your bot any message and cctab picks this up by itself.

min_seconds.title: Starting quiet threshold, in seconds
min_seconds.description: Shorter tasks send nothing. This is only the starting value: send /settings to your bot and change it with buttons from your phone. Default 1800.

statusline_command.title: Your existing statusline command (optional)
statusline_command.description: Rate limits reach the statusline slot only, never hooks. Put your current statusline command here and cctab runs it untouched after reading the numbers.

use_usage_api.title: Fall back to the usage endpoint (off by default)
use_usage_api.description: Set to true only if you skip the statusline wrapper. It reads your local OAuth token and calls an undocumented Anthropic endpoint. Cost still works with this off.

name_tasks.title: Label each task using Haiku (off by default)
name_tasks.description: Set to true to have a short task name in every push. Costs one small Haiku call per session, billed to you.
